conventions.convention: Sites form Z^d with the max-coordinate metric and fixed finite spin dimension. Interaction terms are self-adjoint and indexed by finite nonempty supports; finite-volume Hamiltonians omit terms extending outside the volume.
The interaction norm sums ||Φ(Z)|| over supports containing both x and y, including x=y; the derivative norm instead sums |Z| ||∂sΦs(Z)||, with the supremum over s outside the support sum.
A spectral-flow band must be a locally fixed spectral cluster, in addition to having a separating gap. Separation alone does not prevent discontinuous changes of selected membership.
E_X traces omitted sites with the normalized trace q^(-|D|) Tr_D and inserts identities on extra sites of X; the empty factor has normalized trace one.
Hilbert inner products are linear in the first argument. The unitary group has strong generator iK, and the scalar spectral pairing uses exp(itE). Countable Choice is explicitly assumed.

Clustering uses the gap in the cyclic ground representation, with frequency gap g=γ/ℏ. A simple ground kernel suffices; uniqueness among positive-energy ground states is separately shown to imply that kernel condition.
Filtered transport uses dimensionless energies and ℏ=1, Fourier transform Ŵ(ω)=∫W(t)exp(itω)dt, Ŵ(ω)=i/ω outside the gap, and P'=i[D,P].
Transport is defined by U'=iDU and α(A)=U*AU, so P(s)=U(s)P(0)U(s)* and states transport by ω↦ω∘α. The displayed inclusion square uses precisely this restricted U and commutes.

load_bearing.statement: For G=F_a with a>0 or F_ρ with ρ>d, a norm-continuous interaction family with M_G=sup_u||Φ_u||_G<∞ has, for disjoint finite nonempty X,Y⊆Λ, ||[α_u^Λ(A),B]|| ≤ (2||A||||B||/C_G)(exp(2C_G M_G u/ℏ)-1) Σ_{x∈X,y∈Y}G(d∞(x,y)). The same estimate holds for the inverse path.

Under Countable Choice, the finite-matrix C*-identity, the stated uniformly bounded C^1 finite-range path hypotheses and uniformly isolated locally fixed bands, D_Λn(s) has self-adjoint local interaction coefficients with uniformly bounded F_ρ-norm for every ρ>d. Every fixed finite nonempty support coefficient converges uniformly in s; finite-volume coefficients are norm-continuous in s.

Assume Countable Choice and a C^1 finite-volume self-adjoint Hamiltonian path with a locally fixed spectral cluster uniformly separated by γ>0, in the stated dimensionless convention. There exists a real odd integrable filter with tails bounded by every inverse power and Ŵ_γ(ω)=i/ω for |ω|≥γ. Its filtered matrix D_Λ is self-adjoint and satisfies P_Λ'=i[D_Λ,P_Λ].

On Z^d with max-coordinate distance, F(r)=(1+r)^(-d-1), F_a(r)=exp(-ar)F(r) for a>0, and F_ρ(r)=(1+r)^(-ρ) for ρ>d are summable and have finite positive convolution constants. The convolution bound for F_a may use C_F independently of a.

For every finite X, E_X is a unital positive contraction on the local algebra with a unique contractive extension to the quasi-local algebra. For B∈A_Y, ||B-E_X(B)|| ≤ Σ_{z∈Y\X} sup_{V∈A_{z} unitary}||[B,V]||.

Assume Countable Choice. For a nonzero separable complex Hilbert space, a densely defined positive self-adjoint K and a strongly continuous unitary group with exact generator iK, every pairing has a finite complex Borel measure μ_{x,y} on [0,∞), with ⟨U_t x,y⟩=∫exp(itE)dμ_{x,y}, total variation at most ||x||||y||, spectral support, and zero-energy atom ⟨P_0x,y⟩.

Assume Countable Choice and the stated separable covariant positive-energy representation with simple ground kernel and frequency gap g>0. For commuting A,B whose expected time commutator is O(t) near zero, I_q=∫exp(-qt²)ω([A,α_t(B)])/(2πit)dt is absolutely convergent and |ω(AB)-ω(A)ω(B)-I_q|≤||A||||B||exp(-g²/(4q)) for every q>0.
